title: Lane Record
description: The authored definition of one orchestration lane — an ordered chain of blocks, possibly spanning multiple repos, that /orchestrate drives together. File layout: one record per lane, at <roadmap_dir>/lane-<name>.json (a mechanical rename of the legacy lane-<name>.txt layout). Sibling to block.schema.json. Governed by D71.

lane.description: The lane's name/slug, matching the <name> in this file's own path (lane-<name>.json).

repo.description: OPTIONAL lane-level default repo. A lane is NOT single-repo in this corpus (planning/close-the-loop/lane-substrate.txt spans seven repo prefixes), so this key is not required and carries no meaning for blocks[]: each block entry requires its own `repo` regardless of this value. Present only so a single-repo lane can name itself once.

roadmap.description: Slug of the owning roadmap directory this lane record lives under.

blocks.description: Ordered chain of blocks this lane drives. Array order IS chain order.

id.description: Canonical block ID, matching block.schema.json's id pattern.

origin_roadmap.description: Slug of the roadmap this block was originally allocated under. Required because a block can be claimed by more than one lane across roadmaps; this is what retires E_LANE_DOUBLE_CLAIM by construction.

repo.description: Repo slug this block runs in. Required per-block, not inherited from the lane-level repo default — a lane is not single-repo in this corpus.

budget.description: Concurrency budget for this lane, mirroring mev's emitted shape exactly. Deliberately omits any field naming the heaviness grouping: that grouping is DERIVED by fleet_concurrency_check.py from the target repo's harness.json, never authored here. Also omits a level field.

heavy.description: Whether this lane is heavy for concurrency-budget purposes. Cross-checked against fleet_concurrency_check.py is-heavy for the lane's repo.

not_with.description: Slugs of other lanes this lane must not run concurrently with.

held_until.description: Date this lane is held until before it may start. Authored lane metadata with no state.json representation.

isolation.description: Isolation policy for this lane's execution (e.g. worktree vs in-place). Authored lane metadata with no state.json representation.

exclusive_repos.description: Repos this lane must run exclusively in — no other lane may touch them concurrently. Authored lane metadata with no state.json representation.

spec_source.description: Where this lane's block specs were sourced from. Authored lane metadata with no state.json representation.

cut_blocks.description: Block IDs originally planned for this lane but cut. Authored lane metadata with no state.json representation.
